Definition: from G5618 and G1487; just as if, i.e. as it were:--as.
BiblicalUsage: hōspereí is a plain word for as it were, just as if. It appears in 1 Corinthians, and each time it carries that same plain sense.
TheologicalSignificance: I read hōspereí plainly — it means as it were, just as if, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
